verdict.rationale: Sentry is a monitoring SaaS platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a Sentry MCP server or endpoint. The agent-tracing docs, the agent-assisted SDK setup, llms.txt and the CLI are adjacent features and do not show an official MCP server that agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
